:::{#exr-bernoulli-loglik-one-group}
#### Log-likelihood of binary outcomes with one event probability

Derive the log-likelihood of $\vy$
from @exr-bernoulli-likelihood-one-group.

:::

{{< slidebreak >}}

:::{#sol-bernoulli-loglik-one-group}

Starting from the likelihood in @thm-bernoulli-likelihood-one-group:

$$
\begin{aligned}
\llik(\prob; \vy)
&= \logf{\prob^{\sumin \outvar_\iobs} (1 - \prob)^{n - \sumin \outvar_\iobs}}
&& \text{(log of the likelihood)}\\
&= \logf{\prob^{\sumin \outvar_\iobs}} + \logf{(1 - \prob)^{n - \sumin \outvar_\iobs}}
&& \text{(log of a product)}\\
&= \paren{\sumin \outvar_\iobs} \logf{\prob} + \paren{n - \sumin \outvar_\iobs} \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(log of a power)}\\
&= \paren{\sumin \outvar_\iobs} \logf{\prob} + n \logf{1 - \prob} - \paren{\sumin \outvar_\iobs} \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(distribute $\logf{1 - \prob}$)}\\
&= \paren{\sumin \outvar_\iobs} \logf{\prob} - \paren{\sumin \outvar_\iobs} \logf{1 - \prob} + n \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(reorder the terms)}\\
&= \paren{\sumin \outvar_\iobs} \paren{\logf{\prob} - \logf{1 - \prob}} + n \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(collect the terms in $\textstyle\sumin \outvar_\iobs$)}\\
&= \paren{\sumin \outvar_\iobs} \logf{\frac{\prob}{1 - \prob}} + n \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(log of a quotient)}\\
&= \paren{\sumin \outvar_\iobs} \logit(\prob) + n \logf{1 - \prob}
&& \text{(definition of $\logit$)}
\end{aligned}
$$

:::
